title: Pointer to the properties of the Weil category
text:
In the notation of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], the following holds. That
this common-stage Weil category is idempotent complete, so that the canonical
functor into its Karoubi envelope is an exact equivalence, is
[lem-weil-weil-complex-qbar-idempotent-complete].
